summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (Argentine 'Relevant Event' notice to CNV/BYMA/MAE) disclosing open-market repurchases of its own book-entry ordinary shares under Article 64 et seq. of Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831. On 2026-11-04 CPSA bought 120,000 shares on BYMA at an average AR$1,708.16, totaling AR$204,979,814, settling 2026-11-05; no NYSE purchases. The company noted same-day acquisitions stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily volume. This is a routine buyback disclosure, not a tender offer: watch subsequent filings for cumulative repurchase totals, treasury-share overhang and any resale or cancellation intentions.
